llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注Ti-6Al-4V合金的后处理电处理，而非增材制造态或工艺态的力学与疲劳性能，因此与本层方向相关性较低。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on a post-processing electric treatment to enhance strength and ductility, not on as-built or process-state mechanical/fatigue characterization of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, which is the core of this layer.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服Ti-6Al-4V合金强度与延展性之间的权衡
summary_zh.method: 采用毫秒级电处理诱导异质纳米结构
summary_zh.result: 屈服强度~1186 MPa，延伸率~16.2%，性能优于已报道的同类材料
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸力学测试验证性能提升

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the strength-ductility trade-off in Ti-6Al-4V alloy by introducing heterogeneous nanostructures.
summary_en.method: A millisecond-level electric treatment (MET) was applied to induce heterogeneous nanostructures in Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.result: The treated sample achieved an outstanding combination of yield strength (~1186 MPa) and elongation (~16.2%), surpassing reported counterparts.
summary_en.validation: Tensile mechanical tests were conducted to validate the enhanced strength and ductility.
